behavior.resolve: Unchanged: resolve(owner='lab') still resolves only the configured exact Lab unit.
behavior.verify: For Lab only, accepts an already-recorded receipt using the exact canonical run-bound Director parent unit. It then verifies the current live process identity, exact systemd InvocationID, exact MainPID, and the process cgroup beneath swapp-gpu.slice.
behavior.aos: Unchanged: an AOS receipt cannot use the Lab canonical namespace.
behavior.other_lab_units: Unchanged: any nonconfigured Lab unit outside the exact run-bound Director namespace is rejected.
